reasons.persona_fit: Perfect fit for an owner-operator; calm, practical tone with restrained dry humor and exact adherence to Bareni's boundary guidelines and zero-CTA rule.
reasons.clarity: Exceptionally clear breakdown of human-in-the-loop design into practical control boundaries (filter, route, approve) that any founder can immediately grasp.
reasons.actionability: Provides a direct, feasible next step: write a single-sentence approval boundary rule, with a clear heuristic for workflow readiness.
reasons.factual_grounding: Accurately frames systems as self-built demos using synthetic data, avoiding any customer claims or unverified capabilities.
